visualCharacteristics.purpose: Data and comparison table on a card surface

contentPattern.structure: One block row per table row; the first row is the column header and the first cell of each body row is the row header. A single-cell row in a multi-column table becomes a full-width group heading

usage: Price/feature comparisons and availability matrices (forms by platform).
reuseGuidance: Use matrix for long, dense item-by-column availability lists with group headings. Check/cross marks can be authored as icons (:check:, :close:).
